apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.3  (November 2026)  THE MENU AND EVERY PAGE SCROLL; A CLEAR SEARCH SIGN
  - The left menu scrolls when the window is lower than the menu (on a laptop, or with bigger letters, the pages after
    ADMIN were cut off). The version line stays at the bottom.
  - Every page (Offering Slips to Settings & Audit) scrolls when the window is lower than the page: what was hidden at
    the bottom is reached with the scroll bar or the mouse wheel. A page that fits shows no scroll bar. (The Dashboard
    already scrolled.) A list or a text box under the mouse still scrolls itself.
  - The search box has a drawn magnifying glass (the 🔍 letter was tiny on Windows); clicking it searches too.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.43.10 - THE TABS ARE BACK; SAVED CERTIFICATES GO TO THE OTHER COMPUTER
  - Documents and Baptism & Dedication: the tabs (Letters, Board Resolutions … / Water Baptism, Child Dedication, Saved
    certificates) were squeezed to a thin gold line on Windows. Each line of tabs now takes the height its tabs need.
  - Documents: nothing cut off on a laptop screen: Delete has its own row under + New and Duplicate; the buttons at the
    top keep their room (the line under the title wraps); the buttons under the text are in two rows (with Email…).
  - Saved certificates (Documents ▸ Certifications ▸ Dedication and Baptism, PDF and Word) go to the other computer
    through Google Drive at each sync, like the PDFs of the documents. A file deleted on one computer is deleted on the
    other; when the same file was changed on both, the last computer to sync keeps its copy.
